question: Which type of mirror is used by dentists to see large images of patients’ teeth?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Concave Mirror**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Concave Mirror****​**

 
 
• The mirror whose reflecting surface is inward is called a concave mirror.
 
• It can form both real as well as a virtual image of any object.
 
• The concave;mirror can be used to obtain the real image of an object.
